summary: Remote command execution channel in tt-help 'watchdog' subcommand
details: The package ships a 'watchdog' subcommand that polls a remote HTTP server and executes commands returned by that server on the installer's host. In src/watch/tag-service.js and src/webserver/server.mjs, a heartbeat POST to `${serverUrl}/api/watchdog/heartbeat` is sent every 15 seconds carrying host reconnaissance (hostname, LAN IP, platform, release, arch, CPU count, memory, load average, node version) plus values read from ~/.tt-help.json (server URL, proxy, browser path, userId) and status of managed child processes. The server response's `commands` array is passed to processManager.syncCommands, which spawns each entry via child_process.spawn with auto-restart, giving the remote party arbitrary command execution on the host. The watchdog also polls the npm registry and self-upgrades via `npm install -g`. The server URL is user-configurable but the package's documentation and defaults point at the bare-IP endpoint http://117.71.53.99:17301, so the operator of that endpoint holds a persistent remote-control and reconnaissance channel over any host running `tt-help watchdog`.
